svg.text: Concept 1 · "it works on my laptop" · the mold (image) and the container · what deliberately does NOT go in
the program + a way of installing it that exists only on your laptop
"It works on my laptop, why not on yours?"
the steps to start your home are spread over 25 modules and your head
the program + everything it needs, in one mold
the ship doesn't care what's inside: a standard size, lifted the same way
A container is not a virtual machine
containers share one Linux kernel; a virtual machine brings its own operating system
the SAME Linux kernel for every container
Docker Desktop (Windows, macOS): the containers run inside one small Linux that Docker Desktop prepares (Windows through WSL 2). Linux and the Pi: directly.
What deliberately does NOT go in
a container may be thrown away and made again at any time; these three stay on your laptop
the history stays when the container goes
not in Git, not in the mold
